column1: # Curated model-warning mapping: method id -> embeds_training_data (true/false).
# A `true` row means the method's saved model keeps the training data inside the model
# file (the L-dialog warning fact; the UI renders the board copy, the app never invents
# a warning). Absent rows default to false. The owner's warn list lands here at the
# first real generation; until then the real registry ships all-false.
